detail.longDescription: 👟 ICYMI: Mechanical engineers at # UCBerkeley studied why shoelaces come undone on their own while # walking or # running . High-speed cameras and pendulums show that repeated foot strikes loosen the center knot while leg swings whip the loose aglet ends free, triggering total failure in two quick stages. 👉 Learn more: https:// seethis.tv/post/whats-the-best -way-to-tie-your-shoelaces # biomimicry # clothes # engineering # experiments # fashion # history # howthingswork # inventions # knots # physics # research # science # shoes # womeninstem # tksst # video
